name: retirementneuron
description: Read-only retirement planning analysis for retirement readiness, spending, Social Security, taxes, Roth conversions, withdrawals, scenarios, and financial risk.
releaseNotes: RetirementNeuron provides authenticated, read-only retirement planning analysis using the user's connected RetirementNeuron household and saved financial plan. Supported capabilities include retirement plan summaries, retirement feasibility, sustainable spending analysis, Social Security timing, retirement tax strategy, Roth conversion analysis, withdrawal strategy, retirement scenario comparison, financial risk analysis, retirement action planning, and explanations of changes in financial analyses. The integration is read-only. It does not execute trades, transfers, withdrawals, Roth conversions, benefit elections, tax filings, account changes, or other financial transactions.

interface.subtitle: Retirement Planning Insights
interface.longDescription: RetirementNeuron provides authenticated, read-only retirement planning analysis using your connected RetirementNeuron household and saved financial plan. Analyze retirement readiness, sustainable spending, Social Security timing, retirement taxes, Roth conversion strategies, withdrawal approaches, scenario comparisons, financial risks, and planning actions. RetirementNeuron does not execute trades, transfers, withdrawals, Roth conversions, benefit elections, tax filings, or other financial transactions.
defaultPrompt: Compare Social Security claiming at age 67 versus age 70.
